compressed_candidate_mass.note: The three Lipo tau classes hold 442+81+91=614 of 702 Train candidates (~87.5%), so '13/16 classes stored exactly' is a class-count statement, not evidence that the compressed structure is small. Class count, candidate count, actual view frequency and held-out structure coverage are different quantities.

note_epoch: Comparing RESP epoch 63 Train RMSE with ADD epoch 91 Train RMSE is not a fit diagnostic: the two selected states are different points on different curves. At the same epoch RESP also has the lower Train RMSE (63: 0.3475 vs 0.3788; 91: 0.2797 vs 0.3018; 360: 0.0835 vs 0.1002), so a fitting/optimisation component cannot be excluded from the S0 Lipo RESP-vs-ADD difference.
